⛓️ Egil brings it home: Emberhold bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Egil speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three weeks. That's how long before a handshake is a relationship — the System will say so when it's true. Tend this fire.
📓 Codex: First link formed with Emberhold. The gesture goes out now; the Dawn waits for seasons.
🎁 Haven's first gesture: 2,000 kcal walks to Emberhold's fire — a gift, no strings. They count it, and they remember who sent it. (Trust +10.)
